market_question: Will Amanda Anisimova be the 2026 Women’s Wimbledon Winner?
reasoning: Amanda Anisimova is a quality player but far from a legitimate Wimbledon contender in 2026. She has never reached a final on grass and her best Grand Slam results came on clay/hard courts. Even elite favorites rarely exceed 15‑20%, and Anisimova sits outside the top‑20 with a weak Wimbledon record. A 6% implied chance prices her as a top‑8 favorite, which is unsupported.
evidence_points: Anisimova’s best Wimbledon appearance was the third round (2022); she has no grass‑court titles.
Current elite players (Swiatek, Sabalenka, Rybakina) are far more likely winners, with each under 25% individually.
Her 2024/2025 ranking hovers around No.30, making a grand slam title extremely unlikely.
